title: New to the AWS community? Start here
description: How to get the most from a meetup, from picking a first talk to following up afterwards. Sample post.
author: sample-organizer-two
body:
Your first meetup can feel intimidating. A few tips help.

- Arrive early; the first half hour is the easiest time to meet people.
- Ask one question in the Q&A.
- Follow up on LinkedIn the next day.

See you at the next one.
